experiments.scope: The blake3-r2-prefix-v1 target. Each trial executes the walk of proof.md 9.8 and 9.9 on the priced instance (flags 3, counter t by step CT) for one context: seven outer words and the number b0 of a representative batch from SHAKE-256 of the seed; the 39 context lines, the four flags and the gate base, and the descriptor table with its case words (computed outside the counter); representative batches b0 to b0 + 3 and the last, 32 clusters; per representative the six-operation key and the straddle gate entry (computed on demand by the rule that fills the table); per opened cluster the addition of u_O to W, the representative's lane test on T2', the byte guard, then the five old partner batches (a fallback) or the descriptor selection, the load of the case word, the comparison tree of the joint dispatch and the leaf with the broadcasts and the two chunks; per lane test (2) on T2'; per E lane the addition to W, the fill of the cached Y9 at the first E lane of a batch, and T1; the passing decision. A counting machine counts the operations, loads, comparisons and branches of the representative batches, opened clusters (with the dispatch tree), chunks, E lanes and fills; address formations, end jumps and the fallback's list bookkeeping are unit counts equal to their charges. Steps 2 and 3 (pre-check, preflight, meter, joint solver, certificate) are not run. In the same run every one of the 32 members of every cluster is recomputed straight-line (all 77 lines of step CO) and tested: omega mod 512 against Lemma KP, the gate entry against S7 and the straddle rule, every partner's omega bits 9 to 13 against the window of Lemma XF, every unwalked partner of an opened cluster and every member of a closed cluster bit by bit for (2), each walked lane's omega, mask of (2), Y9 and X against the scalar outer step. The returned pair is one root-instance trial of proof.md 6.1 (counter 0, flags 11) for words taken from the seed, built from the assignments of G and their inverses alone.
experiments.hypothesis: For every trial the two complete 2-round digests (counter 0, flags 11) agree on digest words 0, 2, 5 and 7, the 128 masked bits (Lemma T, proof.md 6.1 and 6.4): an exact claim on concrete inputs. The observations are the program's own counts, untrusted and not recomputed by the organizer: clusters, opened, fallbacks, walked (lane tests), e_lanes, fills, passes, checks, mismatches (a member check that fails, or a block whose counted units differ from its charge of proof.md Section 11: an opened cluster above u_O = 134, a fallback above 261, a representative batch other than 59 (45 for the last), an E lane above 7, a fill other than 56), skipped_pass (a member that passes (2) but is not walked), open_units_max (the largest counted opened cluster), chunk_lanes_max (the largest n_A + n_B) and work (W at the end of the trial, without the u_P of passing lanes and without fallback premiums). Expected per trial: 32 clusters, about 40 per cent opened (proved bound 0.4064), mismatches and skipped_pass 0, open_units_max at most 134. In the participant's local replay of the public request (256 trials, the organizer's runner with a subprocess in place of the container): 3,312 of 8,192 clusters opened, 4 fallbacks, 30,574 lane tests, 14,867 E lanes in 3,708 fills, 315 passes, 562,930 checks, 0 mismatches, 0 skipped passes, largest opened cluster 134 units, largest n_A + n_B 9. The counter instance cannot be digest-checked by the organizer, and the run is not evidence of attack cost or of any rate.
